sdk_integration_plan.scope_rule: All SDK-eligible child L3 are delivered with their public adapter; host-internal/governance work records an explicit reason instead of exposing private state.

baseline.qualification: Planning baseline only; source presence and runtime metadata are not new execution evidence.

sdk_integration_plan.owner_specific_task: History service public trước; UI toggle/update và plugin feature persistence cùng contract.
tasks: Audit exact L3 source and standalone evidence; reuse the existing Rust service where present. Do not infer completion from planning metadata.

For an SDK-eligible feature, implement public DTO/wrapper/capability and host dispatch in the same owner delivery as the application service; existing completed core code receives an explicit SDK retrofit task here.
Preserve units, coordinate spaces, permissions, revision/identity, budgets, cancellation and host-owned atomic transaction/Undo semantics.
Verify an external plugin built from the public SDK, geometry/metadata parity, error/Cancel/Undo/Redo and persistence where relevant; prove each advertised native target separately.
Update this owner, its affected L3 traceability/runtime evidence, API inventory/example and live ledger; keep unverified SDK scope open without erasing prior core evidence.
sdk_integration_plan.completion_rule: For SDK-eligible scope, the owner delivery includes the public contract, host route, shared service and external plugin evidence. Host-internal exceptions require a documented ownership reason. Existing business/manual gates remain in force.
sdk_integration_plan.target_evidence_policy: Windows and macOS execution are recorded separately; shared source or a package target entry does not prove macOS runtime.

cage_smart_flow_history_2026_11_17.scope: Cage Edit, Smart Flow and Pull Down carry source geometry and metadata through the Join History worker; tested two-level output, Undo/Redo, failure and cancel. Source calculations and other source-edit families remain open.

addon_history_edits_2026_11_17.scope: Interactive add-on Geometry/Placement source edits with optional same-document Inserts and Extensions rebuild Join History in one worker transaction; unsupported mixed mutations including parent deletion refuse. Tested through an in-process Matrix Scale and scripted mixed reply; exact-source replacements and other source-edit families remain open.

transform_menu_fixture_migration_2026_11.scope: The Transform menu's synthetic native-source display fixtures now use the legacy migration owner; all 50 fixtures pass with and without default features. This does not certify native topology or complete Join History.

history_dependent_candidate_2026_11_17.scope: MatrixApp parent grip edits, gumball gestures, numeric and tested Transform menu operations, single-piece Trim and non-copy Move/Rotate/Mirror commands feeding Join History schedule source and descendant updates on the worker. Interactive mutual and one/two-surface Trim retain their sessions on success/failure/cancel; Trim geometry and partitions are still prepared on the caller. Headless fixtures cover two levels, command-editor input and menu-origin dispatch, Undo/Redo, failure, simulated grip drag and reopen. Mixed Mirror includes points, meshes, surfaces, instances and an OCCT box with placement; other source edits, native/producer peak bounds, desktop latency and Join History creation routes remain open.

history_atomic_source_update_2026_11_17.scope: Same-transaction geometry/placement edits can accompany a clean HistoryUpdate using staged source stamps; final world validation and one Undo are tested. Host automatic propagation remains open.

join_history_interim_refusal_2026_11_16.scope: The add-on refuses its sampled non-associative operation instead of deleting parents. Scoped host fixtures cover canonical placed-curve creation, recipe/Undo, save/open and explicit recompute. Automatic propagation, command routing and lifecycle acceptance remain open.

tools_menu_audit_2026_11_16.scope: Tools menu audit: compare this owner with Book2, relevant decompile and current built-in/add-on routes. Existing handler/tests are partial evidence; see per-command gaps in plan.

center_controller_history_2026_11_17.scope: Center Object controller placements and dependent Join History rebuild publish atomically; no menu/CMD route established.

top11_parent_guard_2026_11_17.scope: Top 11 ordinary publication refuses unhandled mutations of update-enabled Join History parents; parent replacement semantics remain unimplemented.
